card.name: Words leading up to chemical structure
card.fires_on: Words just before a likely 'structure' or 'structurally', such as 'chemical', 'close', 'are' and 'shares', when a label compares related drugs.

modes.label: Chemical before structure
modes.description: The word 'chemical' where 'structure' or 'similarities' comes next.
modes.example: The<< chemical>> structure of oxcarbazepine is

modes.label: Drugs described as related
modes.description: Linking or similarity words in statements that two drugs or classes are alike.
modes.example: the two drugs<< are>> structurally related and have similar biologic

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict 'structure' (and 'structurally') as the next word.
card.plain: It fires when a label is about to say that drugs are alike in chemical structure.
